exposure: Changes to antenatal and postnatal care (fewer face-to-face, increased virtual appointments)
Changes in guidance about COVID-19 vaccine suitability
outcome: Maternity service users' experiences of communication
Perception of COVID-19 vaccine information adequacy
cohort: The cohort consisted of 16 maternity service users aged 28-44 who gave birth using NHS maternity services in England.
finding: Participants experienced poor communication and limited general and maternal health information during the COVID-19 pandemic, alongside inadequate COVID-19 vaccine information, which affected their understanding of service changes and led to a desire for clearer guidance.
